newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EIB TO DECIDE ON S.AFRICA SALDANHA BAY LOAN - EU.
newsitem.headline: EIB TO DECIDE ON S.AFRICA SALDANHA BAY LOAN - EU.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it was for the European Investment Bank to decide on whether to grant a loan in support of South Africa's Saldanha Bay steel project.

A spokesman for European Economic Affairs Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy said that the Commission, which sits on the EIB's board of governors, had given its opinion on the loan last week but declined to say what that opinion was.
The EIB board also includes the finance ministers of the EU's 15 member countries.
"The decision will be taken by the board of governors of the EIB," the spokesman added.
According to press reports on Monday the Commission has proposed blocking a $78 million loan to the South African project, which is jointly owned by Iscor and the Industrial Development Corp (IDC).
Saldanha Steel chairman Bernhard Smith told Reuters on Monday he had not yet been informed of the European Commission's decision.
"We've got somebody from the IDC in the UK trying to find out...We have heard nothing today and at the moment I cannot confirm or deny it," Smith said.
